name: Manhattan Village
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air shopping destination in Manhattan Beach featuring premium retailers, dining, and entertainment options. The center offers a sophisticated shopping experience with carefully curated brands in a coastal Southern California setting.
demographics: Manhattan Village serves an affluent coastal community with high household incomes, typically exceeding $150,000 annually, and a demographic mix of young professionals, established families, and empty nesters aged 30-65. The trade area encompasses the prestigious South Bay beach cities including Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, and Redondo Beach, attracting quality-conscious shoppers who prioritize premium brands and experiential retail. Visitors demonstrate strong spending power with preferences for upscale fashion, specialty retail, and elevated dining experiences that align with the beach community's sophisticated lifestyle.
